3. The short facts relevant are that CS Plot No. 1009 measuring an area of 0.60 acre of land appertaining to CS Khatian No. 225 of mouza Kafrul, JL No. 268 under former PS Keraniganj was owned and possessed by its recorded tenants namely; Sobhan Matbar and Nazar Bibi in equal share. The said Khatian is annexed to the petition as Annexure-A. Nazar Bibi while in possession and having title along with her sons sold to the petitioner 0.08 acre of land out of plot No. 1009 from the southern side by a Registered sale deed dated 27-4-59 marked Annexure-B to the petition. After purchase petitioner has been possessing the same by constructing semi pucca structures, got her name recorded in SA Khatian No. 225 (old) and 161 (new) and by opening Holding No. 69 Agargaon with Dhaka Municipal Corporation paying rents and taxes to the Municipality for the same. Photo copy of the rent receipts of the Tahsilder in favour of the petitioner and Municipal Tax receipt granted in favour of the petitioner are marked as Annexure-C and C1. 

 12. Mahmudul Islam, the learned Advocate for the petitioner, submits that 0.06 acres of land of plot No. 1009 of CS Khatian No 225 of mouza Kafrul under former police station Keraniganj, presently Police Station Mohammadpur, Dhaka having not been requisitioned and acquired in Land Acquisition Case No. 41 of 1964-65, the Gazette Notification dated 27-10-86 Annexure-G purporting to treat it in the aforesaid Land Acquisition Case without taking steps for acquisition of the said land under Ordinance No. II of 1982 is illegal and without lawful authority. He further submits that the gazette notification Annexure-G treating the aforesaid 0.06 acre of land as acquired in Land Acquisition Case No. 41 of 1964-65 is malafide and for ulterior purpose inasmuch as it has been published to deprive the petitioner of her lawful right to compensation at the present market rate. He further submits that by Gazette Notification dated 26th July, 1983 only 0.45 acre of land from the northern portion out of the area more or less 186.0752 acres of land of plot No. 1009 has been requisitioned as per Annexure-E and the notice in Form A of requisition issued by the Deputy Commissioner, Annexure-D show 0.45 acre of plot No. l009 of Mouza Kafrul, JL No. 268, PS Keranigarij have been requisitioned and now by Gazette Notification dated 27-10-86 Annexure-G, cannot be rectified by the. Government by saying in place of 0.51 acres earlier it was mentioned as 0.45 acres which includes the land of the petitioner is absolutely illegal, malafide and without any lawful authority. He submits that unless the property is requisitioned under section 3 of the Emergency Requisition of Property Act, 1948 it cannot be acquired under section 45 of the Act.
